57:1: Everything that is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Allah. He is the Mighty, the Possessor of wisdom.
57:2: The dominion of the heavens and the earth belongs to Him, He gives life and causes death, and He is capable of all things.
57:3: He is al-Awwal and al-Akhir and az-Zahir and al-Batin, and He is the Knower of all things.
57:4: He is the One who created the heavens and the earth in six days, then istawa over the Throne. He knows what enters into the earth and what comes out from it, what descends from heaven and what ascends into it. And He is with you wherever you are. And Allah is Seeing of what you do.
57:5: The dominion of the heavens and the earth belongs to Him, and all matters are returned to Allah.
57:6: He causes the night to enter into the day and causes the day to enter into the night, and He is the Knower of the essence of the breasts.
57:7: Believe in Allah and His Messenger, and spend from that which He has made you successors in; for those among you who believe and spend, there is a great reward.
57:8: What is the matter with you that you do not believe in Allah? Whereas the Messenger is calling you to believe in your Rabb, and He has certainly taken a firm pledge from you.
57:9: It is He who sends down clear verses upon His servant so that He may bring you out from darkness into light. Indeed, Allah is to you Most Kind, Most Merciful.
57:10: What is the matter with you that you do not spend in the way of Allah? The inheritance of the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah. Those of you who spent and fought before the conquest are not equal (to those who spent and fought after). Those are greater in degree. Allah has promised the best to all of them. Allah is fully aware of what you do.
57:11: Whoever lends to Allah a good loan, He will multiply it for him manifold, and for him there is a generous reward.
57:12: On that Day you will see the believing men and the believing women with their light running before them and on their right: 'Today good tidings for you: Gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein; that is the great triumph.'
57:13: On that Day the hypocrite men and the hypocrite women will say to those who believe: 'Look at us, let us take a part of your light.' It will be said: 'Turn back behind you and seek a light.' Then a wall will be set up between them; it has a gate; on its inner side is mercy, and on its outer side is punishment.
57:14: They will call out to them: "Were we not with you?" They will say: "Yes, but you caused yourselves to fall into fitnah, you waited, you doubted, and vain desires deceived you, until the command of Allah came, and the deceiver deceived you concerning Allah."
57:15: Today no ransom will be accepted from you, nor from those who disbelieved. Your shelter is the Fire. It is your mawla. What an evil destination!
57:16: Has the time not come for the hearts of those who believe to feel humility for the remembrance of Allah and for what has come down of the truth? And that they should not be like those who were given the Scripture before; the term became prolonged for them, so their hearts hardened; and most of them are fasiqun.
57:17: Know that Allah gives life to the earth after its death. We have certainly explained the verses to you so that you may use reason.
57:18: Indeed, the men who give charity and the women who give charity and those who lend to Allah a good loan, it will be multiplied for them manifold, and for them is a noble reward.
57:19: Those who believe in Allah and His messengers, it is they who are the siddiqun. And the martyrs, with their Rabb they have their reward and their light. Those who disbelieved and denied Our signs, it is they who are the companions of Hellfire.
57:20: Know that the life of this world is only a play, an amusement, an adornment, a mutual boasting among you, and a rivalry in wealth and children. Just like a rain whose vegetation astonishes the disbelievers, then it dries up and you see it turned yellow, then it becomes debris. And in the Hereafter there is severe punishment and forgiveness and pleasure from Allah. The life of this world is nothing but a deceptive enjoyment.
57:21: Race toward forgiveness from your Rabb and a Paradise whose width is like the width of the heaven and the earth. It is prepared for those who believe in Allah and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allah; He gives it to whom He wills. Allah is the Possessor of great bounty.
57:22: No calamity strikes upon the earth or in your own selves but it is in a book before We bring it into being. Indeed, that is easy for Allah.
57:23: So that you may not grieve over what you have lost, nor exult over what He has given you. Allah does not love any arrogant boaster.
57:24: Those who are stingy and command people to stinginess. And whoever turns away, then indeed Allah, He is the Self-Sufficient, the Praiseworthy.
57:25: Certainly, We sent Our messengers with clear proofs and sent down with them the Scripture and the Balance so that people may stand in justice. And We sent down iron, in which is severe might and benefits for the people, and so that Allah may know who helps Him and His messengers in the unseen. Indeed, Allah is Strong, Mighty.
57:26: Certainly We sent Noah and Abraham, and placed in their offspring prophethood and the Scripture; and among them is he who is guided, and many of them are fasiqun.
57:27: Then We sent Our messengers in their footsteps one after another, and We sent Jesus, son of Mary, after them, and We gave him the Injil, and We placed compassion and mercy in the hearts of those who followed him. A monasticism which they innovated, We had not prescribed it upon them (had not made it obligatory), except to seek the pleasure of Allah. Then they did not observe it with its due observance. So We gave those among them who believed their reward. And most of them are fasiqun.
57:28: O you who believe, fear Allah and believe in His Messenger, that He may give you two portions of His mercy, and make for you a light by which you will walk, and forgive you; and Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
57:29: So that the People of the Scripture may know that they have no power over anything from the bounty of Allah; bounty is in the hand of Allah, He gives it to whom He wills; Allah is the Possessor of great bounty.
